blueprint.title: QuayReady — Inbound Container & Berth Exception Triage Engine
blueprint.persona: Terminal Operations Dispatcher & Warehouse Intake Coordinator
blueprint.businessProblem: Warehouse and quay operators currently track incoming containers, customs holds, and seal discrepancies across fragmented spreadsheets and email threads. Delays and damaged seals are reported too late, causing demurrage penalties and unsafe gate handovers. We need a unified exception desk to register incoming containers, track ETA delays, report physical/customs anomalies, and trigger SLA escalations.

requirements.title: Inbound Container Registration & Seal Check
requirements.statement: Register container ISO number, carrier, berth slot, and physical seal integrity status in one structured view.

requirements.title: Delay & Demurrage Risk Tracking
requirements.statement: Highlight ETA drift in minutes/hours and flag containers approaching customs or cold-chain SLA thresholds.

requirements.title: Discrepancy Reporting & Hold Escalation
requirements.statement: Allow operators to log seal mismatch, customs hold, or reefer temperature excursion and place an immediate gate hold.

requirements.title: Filter by Berth Status & Exception Severity
requirements.statement: Filter containers by All Inbound, Delayed (>2h), Seal/Customs Hold, and Cleared for Gate.

requirements.title: High-Contrast Warehouse Readability (WCAG AA)
requirements.statement: Ensure all status badges and container IDs meet >= 4.5:1 contrast with monospace ISO container formatting.

requirements.title: Explicit Empty, Loading & EDI Timeout States
requirements.statement: Render clear operational states when no containers match a filter, during EDI sync, or when PCS feed times out.

userStories.iWant: to register an incoming container and immediately flag a broken or mismatched seal number
userStories.soThat: the container is placed on gate hold before unloading begins
acceptanceCriteria: Given container MSCU-849201-4 arrives at Berth Q-14 with a seal mismatch
When the coordinator clicks "Place Gate Hold & Log Exception"
Then the container status updates to HOLD_ESCALATED and notifies customs compliance.

userStories.iWant: to filter delayed reefer and customs-held containers sorted by SLA urgency
userStories.soThat: we prevent cold-chain spoilage and demurrage fines
acceptanceCriteria: Given multiple inbound containers with varying ETA delays
When I filter by "Delayed / SLA Risk"
Then containers exceeding 120 minutes delay are prioritized with their exact demurrage countdown.

legacyIssuesRemediated.description: Legacy terminal sheet used light amber #FBBF24 text on #FFFFFF background (contrast 1.67:1, unreadable in warehouse lighting).
Container registration, delay tracking, and discrepancy reporting were buried across 7 separate modal popups.
No offline/EDI feed timeout banner or empty berth filter state was designed.
